body:
- [feaLib] Escape `"` and `\` when writing names back out with `asFea()` in `FeatureNameStatement`, `STATNameStatement` and `CVParametersNameStatement` (#4321).
- [scaleUpem] Also scale the `MATH` lengths that are not `MathValueRecord`s (`DelimitedSubFormulaMinHeight`, `DisplayOperatorMinHeight`, `MinConnectorOverlap`, etc.) (#4327).
- [cffLib] Inherit the initial CFF2 `vsindex` from the Private DICT when decompiling, specializing and instancing charstrings, and fix `programToCommands` miscounting operands when several `blend` operators precede the first stem or moveto (#4337, #4339).
- [instancer] Round CFF2 outlines and stem hints on absolute positions rather than per relative operand, and keep CFF2 Private DICT blend values at full precision until they are written back (#4338, #4341).
- [cffLib] Preserve CFF2 Private DICT arrays that use more than one `blend` group (#4346).
- [feaLib] Raise `FeatureLibError` instead of looping forever on an unclosed `OS/2`, `BASE` or `STAT` table block (#4347).
- [designspaceLib] When a variable font overrides some `public.fontInfo` keys, merge them with the root-level font info instead of replacing it (#4336, #4340).
- [instancer] Raise an error for `FeatureVariations` conditions of a format other than the supported axis-range one, instead of silently dropping them (#4348).
- [filesystem] Don't overwrite an unrelated sibling `.zip` when writing a `.ufoz` or other non-`.zip` archive (#4342).
- [glyf] Fix exponential running time on composite glyphs that reuse the same component at several nesting levels; `getCoordinates` now raises `TTLibError` past 65535 composite points (#4325).
- [ttLib] Add support for the beyond-64k tables of the final ISO Open Font Format 5th edition: uppercase companion tables (`GLYF`, `GVAR`, `HMTX`, GSUB/GPOS extended layout, `FeatureVariations` 1.1, TTC 1.1/2.1, `DMAP`), a `ttLib.beyond64k` module and CLI, and support in `FontBuilder`, `merge`, `subset`, `instancer`, `qu2cu`, `removeOverlaps` and `scaleUpem` (#4097, #2678).
- [VARC] Keep `addVarComponent()` locations sparse, passing `RESET_UNSPECIFIED_AXES` via a new keyword-only `resetUnspecifiedAxes` pen argument (#4349).
- [woff] Require `brotli` >= 1.2.1 and `brotlicffi` >= 1.2.1.0, which fix GHSA-9v8h-qqgm-4m35 (#4365, #4370).
- Build Windows ARM64 wheels (#4366).
- [instancer] Fix `AttributeError: ElidedFallbackNameID` when updating font names of a font with a version 1.0 `STAT` table; fall back to the subfamily name (#2933, #4371).
